steps.name: VERY IMPORTANT: If you want to make this alt into a slayer lure alt, DONT complete the following quests: Dragon Slayer 1, Priest in Peril, Elemental workshop 1, Contact!, Death Plateau, Olaf's quest, Cabin fever, Regicide and Desert Treasure

your acc now has 75 quest points if you followed the starter alt guide. you can complete a few easy quests to unlock the second block slot OR just do all your black demon tasks (takes longer and costs more)
IF going for just 1 block you should do atleast Horror from the deep to unlock dagannoths as a slayer task
But first you should do combats and unlock/buy some items
Unlock preserve (get 70 pray if you only got 43 at the start)
Buy combat gear: b ring, fury, manacles, granite hammer, Regen brace, full obby + shield, sword and berserker necklace
Train melees to 65 att, 65 str and 60 def at sand crabs (granite hammer till 60 att, then d scim till 65/65/60 + use super combat pots)
Get dragon defender (full obby + berserker neck) (train strength)
Fishing contest, cooks assistent, RFD Cook & RFD dwarf for acces to Rock cake when doing absorbtion method in nmz
Move your house to Relleka
One small favour (2 QP) — smith some iron items for 30 smithing, Use lamps on agility
Muder Mystery (3 QP)
Black knights Fortress (3 QP)
Kings ransom (1 QP) — use lamp on woodcutting if doing sins of the father later
Romeo & Juliet (5 QP)
Goblin Diplomacy (5 QP)
Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl (0 QP)
Horror from the deep (2 QP) — Unlocks dagannoths
Fishing contest (1 QP) — better to do b4 nmz so you can use rock cake to stay low hp
Cook's assistent (1 QP)
RFD Cook (1 QP)
RFD Dwarf (1 QP) — Rock cake for nmz
START Fremennik isles (0 QP) — unlocks ice trolls
Train your combats to 80-85 str, 75 att and 74 (1158k xp) def in nmz
Use Custom rumble in nmz with: King roald, Count draynor, Tree spirit, Sand Snake, Khazard warlord and Me
Imbue Berserker ring as soon as possible
Complete Knights training ground for piety unlock
Get a fire cape with melee if possible
IF making just a Rune dragon alt stop here and go to next tab
Buy amulet of Torture when 75hp if you have the money
Use bandos OR Obsidan armour ALWAYS PRAY PIETY (can use monk robes for more afk)
Boost 9 tasks with Turael and 10th with Nieve, do this three times so you have 180 points (if you get Black demon/fire giant/hellhoud/greaters on your first couple nieve tasks just do them)
Do Porcine of intrest for 30 more slayer points and block Black demon and Fire Giant when you get them
Keep doing this task list till 85 slayer or 93 if you want to lure smokes
85  slayer takes around 65 hours to get and 93 slayer around 140 hours
Only go for 93 slayer if you plan on doing post 99 slayer on the main OR if you have enough gp to max already
AFTER you are done with slayer, Get 70 agility for a ring of endurance for luring abyssal demons and dust devils
If stopping at 85 slayer, do Priest in Peril to get a nechryael task on your alt. Luring with a trident with high mage level and gear while being on task really speeds up the task.
ALWAYS USE NIEVE
Kalphite (slaughter) at Kalphite cave / Soldiers — Block: Black demon; Skip: Greater demon (untill 70 slayer, after that only do when you need points)
Dagannoth (slaughter) at Lighthouse — Block: Fire giant; Skip: Hellhound
Suqah (expeditious) at North spot on lunar isle — Skip: Turoth (55 slayer)
Ankou (expeditious) at Nieve cave or catacomb — Skip: Zygomites (57 slayer)
Troll (expeditious) at Jatizso north / Ice trolls — Skip: Wyrm (62 slayer)
After 70 slayer — Skip: Kurask (70 slayer)
Greater demon (expeditious) at Chasm of fire — Skip: Drake (84 slayer)
71 craft + 4 boost and unlock slayer rings
Train att and def to 75 to unlock Dihns bulwark for speccing at kalph, dags, ankou in catacombs
Get 80 attack if you can afford a Ghrazi Rapier
Bludgeon is slightly better for kalphite and trolls but using whip + fremennik shield is probably better for afking trolls
Place your house in Relekka to get to dagannoths in lighthouse (30con)
Use glory tele to al kharid or redirection scroll on house tab to Pollnivneach and take the carpet to get to kalphites
Catacomb ankou are more afk but slower
For suqah you might have to do 2 trips if no bandos/barrows
Can sometimes skip suqah if you get close to max amount and if you have enough points
Use battlefornt teleport to get to the Chasm of Fire, bring antidote for lizardmen
Slayer sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ftKGzCWc4l71qjVJv9obHbM_-GCm-xsAqmh7b90ZscA/edit#gid=1094778124
After you finished your slayer goal you can make this account into a wyvern alt, Brutal black dragon alt or rune dragon alt
Wyverns ~150m bis Gear — 1m+ gp/h
Do elemental workshop I
Read section in the skilling methods discord. basically just need gear and you can start
Rune dragons ~100m Bis Gear — 1.3m gp/h
In depth guide on next tab
Do MM2 (70 craft, 60 hunt) for dragon jav head drops from rd
Do quests till 200 qp (make sure to do all pre req quests for ds2 and unlock barrow gloves before hitting 200 qp)
Get stats for ds2
most notable: 70 smith, 68 mining
Train combats to base 90-95 in nmz
Brutal Black dragon — 1.2-1.7m gp/h
Doing 85 slayer should give you close to 90 ranged from cannoning
Do MM2 (70 craft, 60 hunt) for dragon jav head drops from bbd
Buy DHCB, rigour, anguish and blessed d hide (~110m)
Optional: get higher prayer lvl for less ppots used
Tbow results in 20 kills/500k GP more per hour
